t: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses,” $177,000.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of additional funds for salaries and expenses. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision. There is no tempting contrary reading here, since no participation-related language appears at all.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses,” $177,000.

opus.w: This section only appropriates an extra $177,000 for salaries and expenses. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. Nothing in the text could reasonably be read as participation.
opus.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses,” $177,000.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriations provision allocating funds for salaries and expenses. It does not mention any interaction with parties outside the federal government, such as public comment periods, advisory committees with non-federal members, or consultation with states or tribes. The actors involved are implicitly federal employees receiving salaries, which falls under internal government operations.
qwen_chat.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses,” $177,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "Salaries and expenses" implies hiring people, and thus participation. However, this is a standard appropriations line item for internal agency operations. There is no mention of outside parties, advisory boards, public comment, or consultation with non-federal entities. The text is purely about funding levels for internal government functions.
